environment.runtime: x64 Windows console in an isolated Windows Server Core LTSC 2022 container
environment.candidate: GNU-target x64 build running in the same Windows environment
environment.fixtures: Generated 4 KiB binary, mixed control bytes and CRLF, and plain DOS text

layout.frame: Black double lines on green with a centered context title
layout.row_colors: Yellow on green, with the selected row in white on black
layout.close_marker: Dark gray [x] in the upper-right corner
layout.function_bar: Numbered slots with empty labels. Wider consoles show F11 and F12 when they fit, then shaded filler.

interaction.PageDown: Select the bottom of the next page
interaction.PageUp: Select the top of the previous page
interaction.Escape_Enter: Dismiss Help without invoking the highlighted action
interaction.F1_inside_Help: Leave Help open at the same row
interaction.caret: The edit or Search caret disappears while Help is open and returns on dismissal.

paired_checks.coverage: Text, Hex, Code, HexEdit, CodeEdit, FindEdit, and list movement
paired_checks.limits: Descriptions use independent wording, and the candidate Help catalog covers a subset of the original. The surrounding view and mouse behavior were outside the comparison. The reference refused the 52x17 console.
